drafts.text:
The rules don't break me on red days.
They break on green ones.
Up a few hundred and size starts feeling safe. The stop starts feeling optional. One more trade feels earned.
Anyone else more dangerous to yourself when you're green than when you're red?
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply to @CandleSpec on the Sep 27 post ('I know the rules. I just stop following them when I'm green.') + the 'rewarded for breaking my rules' mechanism seen on @TopstepGal (mechanism only).
drafts.why: The account's strongest reach+reply format, built on a real line he already said, and it names a trap almost every funded trader recognizes. It's also exactly what his own trade history shows.
drafts.why_es: El formato más fuerte de la cuenta en alcance+respuestas, montado sobre una línea real que ya dijo, y nombra una trampa que casi cualquier trader fondeado reconoce. También es justo lo que muestra su propio historial de trades.

drafts.text:
I've proven I can take money out of a funded account.
I haven't proven I can keep one alive after.
Two different skills. I only ever practiced the first one.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply to @mTraderNDX on the Sep 27 post ('I already proved I can take the money out. I haven't proved I can keep the account alive.').
drafts.why: Real self-quote, already nearly a finished aphorism. Short, citable, a contrast most of his audience lives.
drafts.why_es: Autocita real, casi ya un aforismo terminado. Corto, citable, un contraste que vive la mayoría de su audiencia.

drafts.text:
Follow up on yesterday.
Three accounts. All three closed around +$750.
Not a monster day. A day I didn't hand back.
It wasn't clean though. Early in the session I took two losses and answered with a 10-lot I had no business taking. Biggest loss of the day.
The calm part came after that. I want to be honest about both.
drafts.source: Real anchor: Jesus's own trade screenshots for the 3 MFF accounts, imported to the journal today (+$753 / +$754 / +$759, and the 10-lot MNQ long at 4:30 AM ET after two losses, -$527).
drafts.why: Uses the proven 'sequel 1-2 days later' mechanism with real numbers, and it corrects the record honestly. Yesterday's post said max size was 4, the screenshots show a 10-lot and a 7-lot. Owning that is on-brand and protects his credibility.
drafts.why_es: Usa el mecanismo probado de 'secuela 1-2 días después' con números reales, y corrige el registro con honestidad. El post de ayer dijo que el tamaño máximo fue 4, las capturas muestran un 10-lot y un 7-lot. Asumirlo va con la marca y protege su credibilidad.
